title: Heavy checks wait on a machine-wide lock instead of flaking under load
notes: Retro 2026-11-26: with several panes running at once, the load average reached 22-50 on 16 cores, and full test suites timed out and failed at random: one new-crm worker ran vitest 4 times; 'all 13 suites that failed pass alone'. Seen in 3 of 5 new-crm sessions and in pragma. Give the worker panes a machine-wide lock (flock on a file under ~/.cache/dashboard, or one the app holds) that full test, build and typecheck runs wait on, wired so a worker in any project uses it without a project change. The work-card and review prompts also tell the worker to rerun only the failed files, never the whole suite, to confirm a failure is load flake.
